summary: CAE Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting Q4 FY2026 results and announced a multi-year transformation plan targeting $125-$150M annual run-rate savings by FY2030. The plan includes removing 10% of commercial simulator fleet, relocating/optimizing over a dozen simulators, reducing square footage and sites, and targeting FY2030 adjusted segment operating income of $950M-$1B with ~100% cash conversion. No price per share, premium, or deal terms are stated. Board leadership executed a successful transition; transformation is internally driven with no external advisor named. Watch for execution updates, cost savings milestones, and simulator fleet rationalization progress.
